description: The project will include up to 147 wind turbine generators.

description: The project will include up to 5 offshore substations.

description: The project will utilize up to 6 offshore export cables.
context_quote: From one (1) or more (no more than five (5)) OSPs within the lease area, up to six (6) offshore export cables will travel a total of 124 miles.

description: Cable installation must avoid sensitive benthic habitats.
